So in like 2 days I'll be leaving for Grand Cayman :o
Then I'll be back on like July 10th or something.

But yeah I'll be inactive for 10 days, but if the hotel has wifi I can get on Skype (in which case I'll be online for the rest of the time). 

Try not to pass me on the leaderboards while I'm gone. Idk what else to say because I lack creativity, and I'll leave off with this gif <3
